unthread_article_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time a knowledge base article changes in Unthread. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, title, content, status, createdAt, updatedAt

unthread_conversation_status_changed_tri.description: Runs each time a conversation status changes in Unthread. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, title, status, createdAt, updatedAt, priority, customerId, assignedToUserId

unthread_new_account_trigger.description: Runs for each new account in Unthread. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, createdAt, updatedAt

unthread_new_article_trigger.description: Runs for each new knowledge base article in Unthread. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

unthread_new_conversation_trigger.description: Runs for each new conversation in Unthread. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, title, status, createdAt, updatedAt, priority, customerId, assignedToUserId

unthread_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs for each new customer in Unthread. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
